model.name: Coordination-root parent renders a ROLLED summary of children (weakest-link + per-child mini-state), not its empty checklist
model.description: The RENDER half of AXIS-3 (paired with R37.34's AXIS-3 LINT, T37.36): a COORDINATION-ROOT parent pin/detail must RENDER a ROLLED SUMMARY of its children's state - weakest-link status + a per-child mini-state - instead of its own EMPTY stored checklist. Tron's exact words: a parent pin shows 'no state at all', because today the rollup is status-ENUM-only (R40.1 CR-4 AC-rollup-parent-status DERIVES the parent status enum) and there is NO rolled-CHECKLIST render. This is the VIEW counterpart of that derivation: the pin/detail renders the rolled child-state so a coordination root is never blank while its children carry state. NOT a lint (that is T37.36/R37.34 AXIS-3) and NOT the structural byte-check (R37.3) - a distinct RENDER feature, owner=expert.

discoverySource.note: AXIS-3 RENDER-half. Root: rollup is status-ENUM-only (R40.1 CR-4 derives the enum) with NO rolled-CHECKLIST render, so a coordination-root pin shows 'no state at all' (Tron). Leaf-pin already shows real state (6e3b320c6); this is the parent-rollup RENDER = ENHANCEMENT, not a blocker.

model.queuePriority: LOW / ENHANCEMENT - BELOW the resolver-half build + the SLICE-A ship-gate (leaf-pin already shows real state 6e3b320c6; parent-rollup render is an enhancement, not a blocker). Owner=EXPERT (render).
model.structuralRuling: NEW S37 sibling req (NOT an AC on R37.34, NOT a child of R37.3). Rationale (check-before-create): the render-half is the VIEW counterpart of the rollup-parent-STATUS derivation (R40.1 CR-4 18ebe066), a DIFFERENT KIND than R37.34's failable LINTS (tester-owned) and R37.3's structural byte-check. Pairing it as an AC on R37.34 would pollute that req's guard-coherence + split its owner (lint=tester / render=expert). So: sibling req, crossRef-linked to the AXIS-3 lint + the rollup law.
model.crossRefNote: RENDER half of AXIS-3 - paired with R37.34's AXIS-3 LINT (T37.36 993b3f2d, owner tester). The VIEW counterpart of R40.1 CR-4 AC-rollup-parent-status (18ebe066, the enum DERIVATION). Renders LIVE via the ONE VIEW BUS (R37.12). Pin context = R40.18.
